title: What Algae Textile Mills Is
definition: Algae Textile Mills: mills spinning algae into textiles.
description:
Algae Textile Mills: mills spinning algae into textiles. This is Future Art, Design & Fashion at its most ambitious — algae bioreactors research, mill logistics engineering and fiber extraction operations converging on a single goal: making mill hulls real.

Why it matters: Future Art, Design & Fashion will decide dye integration outcomes this century. Algae Textile Mills is one of the load-bearing ideas: without working mill hulls, the larger algae bioreactors vision stalls, and with it, the mill logistics systems that depend on it.

This database documents Algae Textile Mills in full: what it is, the real research behind it today, the pieces it is built from, dated forecasts, runnable demo programs, and a teaching ladder from foundations to mastery. Every record carries a working program you can run.

title: Real Research Today: Algae Textile Mills
definition: Today's documented research behind Algae Textile Mills.
description:

3D-printed fashion (Iris van Herpen) moves from runway to research labs. Together these programs form the algae bioreactors foundation that Algae Textile Mills will build on — the mill logistics results, the fiber extraction methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as mill logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

title: Readiness Estimator: Algae Textile Mills
definition: Estimates Algae Textile Mills readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Algae Textile Mills components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a mill hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Algae Textile Mills Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Algae Textile Mills: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Algae Textile Mills — mills spinning algae into textiles.

Phase 1 — Prove (algae bioreactors): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (mill logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (fiber extraction): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (dye integration): mill hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and textiles-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
